description: DEMO ONLY: made-up loop tasks for the dry run and the unit tests. Not a study task; the Study 2 tasks are sealed elsewhere and supplied at run time.

steps.request: Create a todo-list service: create, list and complete todo items, kept in memory.
Let users attach tags to todo items and list the items with a given tag.
Add an optional due date to todo items and list the overdue items.
